rv.q: Signature Theatre should be applauded for presenting this penetrating and powerful musical during these challenging times.
Signature Theatre’s regional premiere of “All The World’s A Stage” has me realizing just how much I’ve taken that for granted in this profoundly heartfelt tale.
A charming new musical about playing characters and exploring media that speaks to the soul hits Signature with cozy direction from Matthew Gardiner and a glowing performance from Deema Turkomani.

cn.t: This intimate four-character musical about small-town lives earns strong reviews for Matthew Gardiner's emotionally resonant direction and standout performances, particularly from Deema Turkomani.
